items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Jed is my left hand, and he’s terrific.

ctx.x: Can you talk about the people you have working with you? Your team at the Vanguard. You have your daughter...

Well, the nice thing about the Vanguard is, it was a family when...and Max didn’t know it was when he hired certain people... Of course, he fired them as soon as he hired them, because if you didn’t do it right, out you go. One he hired back, we fired a couple of times—Jed. Jed is still there today. And Jed is my left hand, and he’s terrific. He’s my memory. He remembers everything that happened there, more or less, and he’s been wonderful. My daughter, Deborah, what can I say? She’s our daughter, and she’s fit…
As Max did, and what few clubs do now is, you still hire for a week. You still hire acts for a week. That’s pretty rare these days.
